model_config._note: VOID-ABLATION CONFIG. this file has always said attention_deux: false, and until the config-by-value fix it did not get what it asked for -- pgptlformer read the key by PRESENCE, so this run trained WITH attention-II. the value is left at false because that is what the file was always asking for and what makes the ablation an ablation; the alternative, flipping it to true, would bake the bug in permanently and destroy the comparison. consequence to know about: any checkpoint bearing run_name ascii-eos-L4-D768-A predates the fix and has attention-II ON. it is not comparable to a fresh run of this file.
